name: Knitting Triprism
description: Feed a steady trickle of qi into the grip hand so the fingers stay light while the point stays firm.

name: Keen Pin
description: Thrust once at the body and again at the same spot before the opponent's guard can settle.

name: Brisk Boltpoint
description: Flick the point across at cheek height to draw a small cut and a flinch with one short motion.

name: Reedscreen
description: Back away two small steps with the point held at the opponent's chest, keeping the blade between you.

name: Stitchbuckle
description: Hook the opponent's wrist with the free hand and pull it onto the waiting point.

name: Braided Rodtip
description: Chain four thrusts in one forward run, each stab starting from the point's return out of the last.

name: Rodtipscorer
description: Shift qi from the grip into the point at the instant of impact so the stab bites harder than its speed implies.

name: Darnflog
description: Meet a descending cut with a prick to the striking wrist, leaving the cut half-formed.

name: Guarding Hairpoint
description: Beat the opposing blade aside with the flat, then send the point back along the same line.

name: Rooted Needlerod
description: Keep the point on the inside line of the opponent's weapon arm so any attack has to pass it.

name: Springing Probe
description: Step back out of range of a failed counter and re-set the point before the opponent recovers.

name: Brutal Seam
description: Slip the head past a thrust by a finger's width and pierce the forward arm in answer.

name: Gripping Thread
description: Catch the opponent's weapon wrist in a qi-hardened palm and stab the exposed ribs while it is held.

name: Reedcordial
description: Touch the point to the opponent's gloved hand to find the gaps between knuckles and straps.

name: Tinyquill Swat
description: Prick into the crease of the elbow as the arm bends, so the limb cannot bear a weapon.

name: Grim Waxgrip
description: Dip low and poke the hollow behind the knee so the leg buckles under its own weight.

name: Doughty Rodbase
description: Flick the point across the back of the ankle where the cord runs close beneath the skin.

name: Darnprop
description: Jab the front of the shoulder socket to numb the arm and stop the swing it was preparing.

name: Lithe Spikeguard
description: Step off along the line of the opponent's weaker side after every joint strike.

name: Tethering Darn
description: Press the point against a cord with a steady push of qi so the limb locks until the pressure lifts.

name: Stitchswat
description: Pierce elbow crease and knee hollow in two chained stabs so the body can neither bend nor brace.

name: Probe Curl
description: Close the last pace with the blade arm tucked back, so the opponent's reach is already behind you.

name: Gleam Tinyquill
description: Brace the free forearm against the opponent's chest and drive a short stab beside it.

name: Stamp Triprism
description: Hook the opponent's elbow with the free arm and draw it across so the underside of the arm opens.

name: Rooted Slimshaft
description: Pivot on the ball of the foot inside the clinch so a short blow glances off the shoulder.

name: Clay Slimshaft
description: Roll one shoulder forward to cover the throat and let the blade ride behind the curve.

name: Brawnreed
description: Duck under the opponent's weapon arm and slide behind the shoulder in one low step.

name: Grim Boltpoint
description: Deliver a rapid rattle of short stabs under the arm while the clinch holds the opponent still.

name: Gall Rodbase
description: Wheel the hips inside the clinch to swing the opponent's weight sideways and open the flank.

name: Discord Stitch
description: Wedge the point between clasped hands or between weapon and binding and twist to pry them apart.

name: Splicepin
description: Stab through the opponent's sleeve into the leather or timber behind it to pin the arm in place.

name: Awlhasp
description: Lay the blade along the forearm in a bar and hold it before the face against a downward blow.

name: Claypin
description: Slip the body a half pace aside as the cut comes down and let it fall through empty air.

name: Brawn Stitch
description: Wrench the point free of pinned cloth in a quick downward snap so the blade is clear for the next thrust.

name: Hairpoint Prop
description: Let the opposing blade slide along the cord of the grip hand and out past the wrist.

name: Poisereed
description: Cross forearm and blade into a bar, turn the opposing weapon along it, and answer with a thrust.

name: Sleet Waxgrip
description: Pin one sleeve and then the other with two stabs so both arms are caught against the target.

name: Brawnawl
description: Stand with blade, arm and rear leg lined up on one thread so the lunge can run true.

name: Grit Seam
description: Coil the rear leg and release it so the whole body launches along the thread line.

name: Brass Rodtip
description: Extend the arm and lead leg together to the farthest point the body can reach and still return.

name: Pirouetting Needlerod
description: Rock the weight back onto the rear leg right after the stab so the lead foot can lift clear.

name: Lassoing Darn
description: Stamp the lead foot and beat the air with the point to draw a parry that is not needed.

name: Seamslap
description: Drop the hips almost to the knee and stab upward beneath a high guard.

name: Fierce Thread
description: Cross the rear foot over the front to close distance fast and finish with a short lunge.

name: Rushing Pin
description: Run past the opponent's side with arm extended, piercing the flank as the bodies cross.

name: Gleam Rodbase
description: Fall forward from a leaning stance with the point just ahead of the body, the back foot pushing off late.

name: Brass Spikeguard
description: Spring back from a missed lunge with qi in the legs and re-set the point at throat height.

name: Rude Darn
description: Poke the point into the eye slit of a helm before the opponent can lower the visor.

name: Gleamreed
description: Jab beneath the rim of a neck guard where the metal rides away from the collar.

name: Raw Slimshaft
description: Push the point between linked rings of mail and twist to part them before the full thrust.

name: Honedreed
description: Prick into the armpit as the arm rises, where plate and mail leave an opening.

name: Unmoving Tinyquill
description: Angle the blade so a plated strike skids across the flat instead of landing true.

name: Draught Pin
description: Circle round a slow armoured opponent in quick short steps to tire his turn.

name: Gleam Triprism
description: Drive a qi-hardened point into a rivet seam of plate and lever the metal apart.

name: Staticprobe
description: Hook the visor edge with the free hand, pull it up, and stab into the gap it uncovers.

name: Recall Rodtip
description: Rest the point against a practice post and learn the weight of the touch through the grip.

name: Recall Spikeguard
description: Touch the opposing blade with the flat and read from its tremor how firmly it is held.

name: Staticstitch
description: Press the point lightly against the opposing blade and then lift it, taking the opponent's rhythm with it.

name: Slinking Thread
description: Leave the contact at the first sign of a changed grip and take two steps back.

name: Gleam Needlerod
description: Read the pressure rising in the opposing blade and stab the open side the instant it commits.

name: Knitting Boltpoint
description: Close the eyes and follow the opponent's blade by the touch of the point alone through qi.
